infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: Mission Trails uses your location while the app is in use to find nearby trails, verify discovery proximity, and track trails you choose to start.
infoPlist.NSMotionUsageDescription: Mission Trails uses motion activity to count your steps and track walking progress during missions.
infoPlist.NSFaceIDUsageDescription: Mission Trails uses Face ID to securely sign you in.
infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: Mission Trails uses your camera to discover hidden relics in augmented reality.

plugins.motionPermission: Mission Trails uses motion activity to count your steps and track walking progress during missions.

plugins.locationWhenInUsePermission: Mission Trails uses your location while the app is in use for nearby trails, discovery proximity, and verified GPS trail tracking.

plugins.faceIDPermission: Mission Trails uses Face ID to securely sign you in.

ios.cameraUsagePermission: Mission Trails uses your camera to discover hidden relics in augmented reality.

plugins.microphonePermission: Allow Mission Trails to use the microphone for voice commands.
plugins.speechRecognitionPermission: Allow Mission Trails to convert your voice commands to text.
